answer_2.quote: The adversarial accuracy (Adv.Acc.) is the accuracy of the last searched examples. The Edit Dist represents the sum of edit distances for all modified words.

answer_4.quote: To examine whether the attacked text preserves its original label, we set up human evaluations to measure the quality of the generated text. We first ask human judges to make predictions on both the original and attacked texts. Then we ask them to identify and correct the modified words in the attacked text.
answer_4.guideline: Human judges were asked to: (1) make predictions on both original and attacked texts; (2) identify and correct the modified words in the attacked text.
